title: Monsoon's gone, El Nino isn't: Why India's weather worries are far from over
content: El Niño is increasingly influencing global weather patterns including agriculture and temperatures in India. Current forecasts predict a warmer winter as El Niño intensifies, which could affect agriculture adversely. Recent monsoon rainfall deficits raise concerns regarding water resources and crop yields moving forward. Different regions may experience varying extremes from drought to flooding in the coming months due to this phenomenon.

title: Asian Para Games: Simran, Praveen, Sachin shine as India's medal tally swells to 62
content: India's athletics team celebrated a remarkable achievement by winning five gold medals at the Asian Para Games. Sprinter Simran and high-jumper Praveen Kumar set new Games records in their categories. The morning session also saw four silver medals added to the total. Success flowed from other disciplines too, such as badminton, para-archery, and para-swimming. With more competitions ahead, Indian athletes aim for even greater achievements.

title: Donald Trump on data centers: ‘Pay the community’ to make them popular
content: Donald Trump announced that data centers are required to produce their own electricity and sell the excess. He emphasized that financial agreements have made unpopular data centers more accepted in communities. Additionally, a recent poll reveals that a significant number of Americans are concerned about the environmental impact of artificial intelligence. Many people support imposing restrictions on constructing new data centers.

title: Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat sleeper may launch November 1; check timings, fares
content: The Vande Bharat sleeper train has a 16-coach configuration, comprising 11 AC three-tier coaches, four AC two-tier coaches and one AC First Class coach. Designed for operations at speeds of up to 160 kmph, the train has a maximum testing speed of 180 kmph, placing it in the semi-high-speed category. However, much of the Indian Railways network currently lacks the infrastructure needed to support train operations at these speeds

title: Steve Smith joins Ponting, Border in elite Aus club, fifth-fastest to 11K Test runs
content: Steve Smith reached 11,000 runs in Test cricket during the second Test against South Africa. He scored 28 runs off 88 balls before being dismissed by Wiaan Mulder at St George's Park. Smith is now the third Australian and the 12th player overall to achieve this milestone. Australia faced difficulties in their first innings, getting bowled out for just 99 runs.

title: Florida couple missed 66 mortgage payments; man's bank lawsuit rejected
content: A Florida couple missed 66 monthly mortgage payments on their Naples property, triggering a foreclosure dispute that began in 2009. During the legal battle, Gregory Brian Myers agreed to deposit $5,000 monthly while appealing the foreclosure. He later sued U.S. Bank, alleging it had violated their agreement. On October 19, 2026, a federal appeals court upheld the dismissal of his lawsuit.

title: Missouri court overturns ruling giving couple ownership of neighbour's road
content: In a notable case from Missouri, a couple gained legal rights to their isolated property via their neighbor's land. Although the court initially granted them ownership of the access road, it later corrected this decision. Ultimately, they received a permanent easement, illustrating the difference between property rights and ownership. The couple can access their property while the neighbor retains the land under the road.

title: Zuckerberg’s wife Priscilla Chan marks 10 years in Hawaii, donates $1.48m to hospital
content: In a remarkable gesture of generosity, Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan have contributed $1.48 million to the Wilcox Medical Center in Kauaʻi. This donation will be utilized to purchase a mobile MRI unit and a 3D mammography machine, reinforcing their decade-long commitment to enhancing healthcare in the community. Overall, their philanthropy has exceeded $4 million, fundamentally improving access to vital medical resources for local residents.

title: Rare Harry Potter first edition, one of 500 hardcovers, sold for $400,000
content: A rare first edition of Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone has fetched a staggering $400,000 at auction. This prized copy is distinguished by its printing errors and unique characteristics, appealing to avid collectors. With only 500 hardcover copies originally issued, many destined for libraries, the sale underscores the enduring allure of the Harry Potter saga, especially in anticipation of its upcoming screen adaptation scheduled for December 2026.

title: WWE Hall of Famers reveal shocking details about fan's privacy invasion
content: While dining at a hotel restaurant, Nikki and Brie Bella encountered an aggressive fan whose comments made them uncomfortable. Feeling unsafe, the twins requested security assistance to remove him, only to find out he later tried to access their hotel room. Adding to their challenges, both sisters have returned to WWE, battling injuries that shape their performances, with Nikki gearing up for a WWE Women's Championship match soon.

title: Jay-Z and the 2027 Super Bowl: 3 artists who could be better choices
content: Reports indicate that Jay-Z has been officially selected to headline the Super Bowl 2027 halftime show, marking a significant moment in the music and sports landscape. Other notable artists in the running included Miley Cyrus, who could infuse the event with vibrant energy; Harry Styles, known for his broad appeal among fans; and Kelly Clarkson, whose powerful vocal performances would have undoubtedly captivated the stadium audience.

title: 'Then, you are not Gen Z?' HC's quip during hearing of CJP leaders; Dipke reacts
content: During a hearing, the Delhi High Court engaged in a light-hearted exchange about Generation Z with Cockroach Janta Party leaders. The court questioned the legal approach taken by the petitioners against the custody extension issued by a Special Executive Magistrate. Concerns were raised about possible violations of prohibitory orders related to protests as well. The petitioners ultimately withdrew their plea after expressing worries about the outcomes of their surety reconsideration.

title: UP bizman death case: Nagpur court grants UP cops transit remand for Shraddha Dubey
content: Nagpur court has provided transit remand to Uttar Pradesh Police for the three accused in a murder case. Shraddha Dubey and her accomplices were arrested following intensive police operations and public tips. The accused had been evading arrest, prompting an increase in the reward for information leading to them. Shiva Sharma's mother expressed gratitude towards the police for their efforts in achieving these arrests.

title: Lonnie Mack's iconic Gibson Flying V guitar and amp sold for $550,000
content: The legendary 1958 Gibson Flying V guitar, famously owned by Lonnie Mack and dubbed 'Number 7', fetched an impressive $550,000 at auction. This auction also featured Mack's 1962 Magnatone Custom 440 amplifier, which was crucial to his distinct sound. Mack's guitar, tailored for his innovative techniques, has had a profound influence on blues-rock music for many years.

title: Delaware plants 75,000th tree across 17 state parks, meets 5-year goal
content: Delaware celebrates the planting of its 75,000th tree in state parks, coinciding with the park system's 75th anniversary. This achievement contributes to a larger goal of planting one million trees by 2030. The initiative features diverse tree species, driven by the support of community volunteers. Notable trees like the American holly were chosen to improve environmental quality and provide inviting spaces for the public.

title: Over half of coal plants face critically low fuel stocks as demand surges
content: India's coal-fired power plants are grappling with alarming fuel shortages, with almost half of them maintaining reserves for less than three days. This comes amid soaring electricity demand driven by rising temperatures and dwindling hydropower supplies. In response, the government has ramped up local coal production while pausing coal imports.

title: What's Chennai's plan to lower flood risk?
content: Chennai's flood risk is increasing due to rapid urban expansion and declining vegetation and water bodies. Recent studies identified particularly vulnerable areas, confirming gaps in drainage coverage and infrastructure. The Greater Chennai Corporation has implemented measures to enhance stormwater drainage networks and prepare for flooding. Initiatives include creating shelters and mobilizing resources to manage water levels during monsoons.

title: China reveals advanced nuclear subs in Pacific test; a look inside its submarine fleet
content: In a significant military advancement, China announced the successful test-firing of a strategic missile by its advanced nuclear submarines in the Pacific Ocean. This milestone underscores the increasing strength of China's underwater naval capabilities aimed at enhancing its military deterrence. While specific details of the missile remain undisclosed, experts suggest that this may signify a pivotal shift in China's undersea nuclear strategy, potentially unsettling US maritime superiority in the Indo-Pacific.

title: Army's top brass meets in Delhi to review modernisation, security and readiness
content: The Army Commanders' Conference commenced in New Delhi on October 21, 2026, and will conclude on October 23. General Dhiraj Seth, the new Chief of the Army Staff, is chairing this biannual event. Defence Minister Rajnath Singh will address the conference on its final day, discussing contemporary security challenges. The conference will review operational readiness, modernisation, and various initiatives for a future-ready force.

title: Virginia sinks 951 tons of bridge concrete to build habitat for fish
content: The Hampton Roads Bridge-Tunnel expansion project involves dismantling an old bridge and using the concrete for artificial reefs. This initiative helps divert demolition waste from landfills while enhancing underwater habitats. Approximately 100,000 tons of concrete is expected to be repurposed for marine life by 2027. The Virginia Marine Resources Commission manages the artificial reefs that support local fisheries and marine ecosystems. This innovative approach connects infrastructure development with environmental sustainability.

title: Margot Robbie's $950,000 Hollywood bungalow later sold for about $1.2m
content: In February 2018, Margot Robbie bought a charming 945-square-foot bungalow in Hollywood Heights for $950,000. After giving it a stylish makeover, she rented it out at various rates. She eventually sold the property in 2021 for around $1.2 million, marking a profitable investment. This venture underscores the appeal of smaller homes in attractive neighborhoods, complementing her extensive property collection across Los Angeles and Australia.

title: Tiger Shroff firing case: 3 accused remanded in police custody till October 31
content: Three individuals connected to a shooting incident with actor Tiger Shroff have been presented in court. Police reports indicated that additional suspects were arrested in Haryana and Delhi. The prosecution is investigating weapon recovery and the implications of destroyed mobile phones. Further police custody was granted to dig deeper into the conspiracy. The shooting occurred while Shroff was leaving a football club, causing injury to his driver.

title: ‘Every time I’m playing, it’s almost a win for me’: Bhambri on injuries & gratitude
content: Yuki Bhambri's tennis career has been riddled with injuries that have hindered both his performance and ranking. Following a promising start to the 2026 season, he encountered obstacles like an elbow injury and quad strain. Nevertheless, Bhambri remains thankful for the chance to compete and is eager to enhance his skills. His story exemplifies resilience and tenacity in overcoming life's challenges.

title: Rafales, Sukhois, Tejas over the Ganga: IAF gears up for grand aerial display in Varanasi
content: Varanasi will host the Indian Air Force's ‘Wings Over Ganges’ aerial display on October 25, 2023. This event will feature fighter aircraft, helicopters, and aerobatic teams performing over the Ganga. The display is part of the service’s 94th anniversary celebrations and will include nine formations. Prime Minister Narendra Modi is expected to attend the aerial show. Rehearsals have already been conducted in Varanasi in preparation for the main event.

title: Delhi AQI jumps from 179 to 244 in a day; GRAP-1 restrictions kick in across NCR
content: Delhi's air quality deteriorated to the 'poor' category, triggering Stage 1 measures under the Graded Response Action Plan. The Commission for Air Quality Management announced restrictions due to rising pollution levels and extended forecasts predicting continued poor air quality. The measures include prohibiting the use of coal and firewood in food preparations and limiting diesel generator use.

title: Putin meets US envoy Witkoff: Ukraine peace, prisoner release among topics disccused
content: Vladimir Putin met with US special envoy Steve Witkoff to discuss potential solutions to the Ukraine conflict. Witkoff presented proposals aimed at reviving negotiations between Russia and Ukraine, emphasizing the need for trilateral talks. During the meeting, they addressed the release of Stephen Hubbard, an American prisoner in Russia, and issues related to economic cooperation.

title: Man finds black rubber piece in juice bottle, wins Rs 22,340 from consumer court
content: A consumer based in Haryana discovered a troubling foreign object—a black rubber piece—inside a Fresca Litchi Drink bottle. This alarming find prompted the individual to seek compensation, leading the district consumer commission to investigate. Tests confirmed the drink was unsafe due to the contaminant. Consequently, Fresca Foods was deemed liable for the quality concerns raised and was ordered to compensate the consumer with Rs 22,340.

title: India crosses 50 medals at Asian Para Games: Simran and Gavit sprint to 100m golds
content: Simran, who won bronze at the 2024 Paris Paralympics, is working her way back with new guide Shivam after her previous guide, Umar Saifi, was banned for a doping violation.

title: Jio IPO bids cross Rs 50k cr after full subscription in 100 minutes
content: Jio IPO: Data from the stock exchanges, updated at 2:45 PM, showed bids for 46.50 crore shares against the 19.75 crore shares on offer. The response establishes a new record for the speed at which an Indian public issue has attracted subscriptions. The speed of Jio's IPO subscription sets it apart from other large public offerings in India.

title: 'Drishyam 3' Box Office collection: Film eyes Rs 360 crore India net milestone

With over Rs. 358 crore net amassed in India and Rs. 556 crore gross worldwide, the Abhishek Pathak directorial is poised to target the Rs. 360 crore domestic net mark while consolidating its position as Ajay Devgn’s highest-grossing film to date.

title: India signs Rs 770 crore deal with BEL for Army radars to counter drone threats
content: The ministry of defence signed a contract worth Rs 770 crore with Bharat Electronics Limited on October 21. This procurement aims to enhance the Indian Army's capabilities in detecting and tracking aerial threats. The Improved Low Level Light Weight Radars can identify mini and micro drones effectively. This initiative is part of India's strategy to bolster domestic defence manufacturing.

title: Harrison Ford's son became a chef: Why kids need freedom to choose
content: Choosing a culinary path over acting, Ben Ford, son of famed actor Harrison Ford, highlights the significance of individuality amidst parental expectations. From the age of twelve, he showcased his culinary skills by cooking for family gatherings. This journey reflects the value of nurturing children's passions and openly discussing the competitive nature of various careers. Ultimately, empowering children to make their own choices fosters their personal growth and self-discovery.

title: Robert Wagner, 96, credits curiosity for 36-year marriage to Jill St. John
content: Robert Wagner and Jill St. John highlight the significance of maintaining interest and curiosity in a long-term marriage. Their relationship, which began in the 1980s, demonstrates the value of discovering new facets of a partner over time. Wagner's perspective suggests that familiarity should not lead to complacency in relationships. They emphasize the importance of continuous engagement in each other’s lives. This approach fosters depth and connection, essential for marital longevity.

title: 'Bismillah, c'est les ténèbres': What the viral message from French protests mean
content: cryptic phrase has spread from placards outside blockaded schools to viral videos . phrase originated in a Snapchat message that students suspect was sent by an undercover police officer . students say it makes fun of someone attempting, and failing to sound like a teenager .

title: Pakistan signs Badr accord with Turkey, Qatar & Indonesia; what it means for India
content: the Badr memorandum was signed in doha by the defence ministers of the four countries . it aims to expand cooperation in military production, strengthen defence capabilities and promote collaboration in technical military training, research and development .

title: ‘Like Ravana in disguise’: BJP accuses oppn forces of plotting 'regime change'
content: BJP MP Sudhanshu Trivedi accuses opposition forces of plotting 'regime change' he says the forces are driven by three agendas: exploiting power for personal gain, creating divisions within society, and harbouring hatred towards Indian culture and religion .

title: Russia's SU-30 fighter jet crashes in Kaliningrad region
content:
Cause of the crash is not known yet

A Russian SU-30 fighter jet crashed in the Kaliningrad region on Wednesday. The cause of the crash is not known yet. however, both pilots werre able to eject safely, thus avoiding any casualties, reported Reuters quoting Russian agency Interfax which cited the defence ministry. (More details awaited)

End of Article

title: Swimming in success: Ravi claims silver, Himanshu wins bronze at Para Asian Games
content: himanshu Nandal finished third in men's 100m breaststroke event in Nagoya . the 22-year-old has been visually impaired since birth due to optic nerve failure . he drew inspiration from his father who played hockey at the national level .

title: UK men's support group grows from 9 to 7,000 weekly, wins national award
content: nine people gathered in 2016 around an idea that was as ordinary as it was important . a decade later, that small meeting has grown into a nationwide support network reaching thousands of men every week . the idea of a personal loss becomes a mission According to the BBC report, Andrew Roberts died by suicide on April 5, 2016 .

title: 105 US lawmakers urge FBI to probe Hindu temple attack plot amid hate crime concerns
content: 105 lawmakers have urged the FBI to investigate an alleged shooting plot at a Hindu temple in Aurora, Illinois . the alleged plot at the Sri Venkateswara Swami (Balaji) temple is a potential federal hate crime . a group of 105 US lawmakers has urged that the FBI investigate the plot . they are citing concerns about anti-Indian, anti-Hindu and broader anti-South Asian hostility .
